given: a stock record already exists for a (sku, location) pair
when: a team member files that same (sku, location) pair again and saves
then: they land on the confirmation for that pair, and no error page is shown

independence.rationale: Distinct from AC3's data outcome (no duplicate stored): this AC observes the user-facing outcome that the collision resolves gracefully to a confirmation, which can break (error page shown) even when only one record is stored, and vice versa.

architectural_notes: E2E: observes the user-facing outcome of the R3 collision path, refiling an existing (sku, location) pair resolves gracefully to the confirmation view with no error page. The boundary (app/routes/) must return a 2xx JSON result (not a 409/500) for the upsert so the SPA routes to the confirmation client-side rather than an error shell. Cross-cutting: this AC guards the graceful-degradation contract distinct from AC3's data outcome; the boundary owns turning the service's create-or-update result into a success response, and the DB unique constraint (PI1) never surfaces as a raw error page. Verified as a real integration test against the paired Lakebase branch.
